kebab_example: aliyun oos create-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-name MyTemplate --content '{"FormatVersion":"OOS-2019-06-01","Description":"Describe instances of given status","Parameters":{"Status":{"Type":"String","Description":"(Required) The status of the Ecs instance."}},"Tasks":[{"Properties":{"Parameters":{"Status":"{{ Status }}"},"API":"DescribeInstances","Service":"Ecs"},"Name":"foo","Action":"ACS::ExecuteApi"}]}' --tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --version-name v2 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxsn4m4000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. The name can be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD开头
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.example: {"FormatVersion": "OOS-2019-06-01", "Description": "Describe instances of given status", "Parameters": {"Status": {"Type": "String", "Description": "(Required) The status of the Ecs instance."}}, "Tasks": [{"Properties": {"Parameters": {"Status": "{{ Status }}"}, "API": "DescribeInstances", "Service": "Ecs"}, "Name": "foo", "Action": "ACS::ExecuteApi"}]}
parameters.help_en: The content of the template. The content must be in the JSON or YAML format, and its maximum size is 64 KB
parameters.help_zh: 模板内容。JSON或YAML格式，长度限制为 64 KB
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The tag keys and tag values. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 标签键和值列表， 标签键值对数量范围是1至20
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The name of the version of the template
parameters.name: version_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

CreatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was created

HasTrigger.description_en: Indicates whether the template was configured with a trigger

Hash.description_en: The SHA-256 value of the template content

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

ShareType.description_en: The share type of the template. The share type of the template that you create is Private
ShareType.description_zh: 模板共享类型。目前用户创建的模板的共享类型均为 Private

TemplateFormat.description_en: The format of the template. The system automatically determines whether the format is JSON or YAML
TemplateFormat.description_zh: 模板格式。系统字段判断，为JSON或YAML

TemplateVersion.description_en: The version of the template. The name of the version consists of the letter v and a number. The number starts from 1
TemplateVersion.description_zh: 模板版本。以“v”+数字的形式，数字从1开始

UpdatedBy.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account that last modified the information about the template

UpdatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was last updated
